einzeiler: Ted Cruz discusses his political career, Donald Trump, and his new book on Clarence…
kurzfassung: Senator Ted Cruz reflects on his 2016 presidential campaign, his relationship with Donald Trump, and the future of the Republican Party. He shares behind-the-scenes political anecdotes and discusses his new biography of Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas. Additionally, Cruz touches on foreign policy views, school choice legislation, and interactions with prominent figures.
stichpunkte: Ted Cruz analyzes the 2016 Republican primary, noting that blue-collar voters were the key predictor of success.
He discusses his shifting relationship with Donald Trump, evolving from primary opponent to a strong Senate ally.
Cruz criticizes Tucker Carlson, accusing him of dangerous rhetoric and spreading anti-Semitic talking points.
He explains his foreign policy stance as a non-interventionist hawk, supporting targeted strength while avoiding nation-building.
Cruz highlights legislative achievements, including authoring provisions for school choice, Trump accounts, and no tax on tips.
He details his personal background, detailing his father's immigration from Cuba and subsequent hardships.
Cruz discusses his new book, 'Going Further, the Incomparable Clarence Thomas,' based on 9.5 hours of exclusive interviews.
beschreibung:
Patrick Bet-David sits down with Senator Ted Cruz to discuss the 2028 Republican race, his differences with JD Vance and Marco Rubio, why he calls Tucker Carlson dangerous, and the alliance he believes could have stopped Trump in 2016. Cruz also reveals private moments involving Trump and Elon Musk.
